name: ns_proofsearch_leray_convexity_trackb
rubric_version_reason: Raises the bar after Phase 5IW/5IX: candidates must use all-output positive-coherence LSC rather than hidden source-L2 pricing, and event-level reciprocal recurrence pricing rather than shell-only harmonic recurrence.
description: Navier-Stokes theorem-search substrate for the fixed-topology LP/Bony/profile all-output continuum LSC and event-recurrence price bridge for the Leray self-tax integral.

cage_meta.class_reason: Qualitative theorem-search over a fixed PDE estimate and smooth escape falsifier, not numerical curve fitting.

theorem_packet_contract.reason: The candidate must engage the live GP-216 / 5IW-5IX bridge directly: fixed profile topology, branch self-tax LSC, positive coherence undercharges, low-beat physical reserve, all-output positive-coherence LSC, event-level recurrence price, global self-tax budget, continuation linkage, and an actual continuum theorem/falsifier or dynamic event-recurrence theorem/falsifier.

disable_evidence_fit_gate_reason: The target is a proof-shaped local-to-global PDE estimate, not data fitting.
disable_uniqueness_gap_gate_reason: The theorem-packet gate evaluates topology, price components, and anti-tautology directly.

premises: event weights a_e with convergent reciprocal event budget
bound_chain.scope: event-level recurrence topology after multiplicity and overlap
fixed continuum Track B budget assembly

special_case_candidates.name: All-output LSC negative-control closure
special_case_candidates.instantiation_hint: construct a smooth fixed-topology prefix where source-L2 stays bounded but all-output positive-coherence price is declared before payoff

special_case_candidates.name: Event reciprocal budget PDE lower envelope
special_case_candidates.structural_barrier_addressed: shell-only or raw-count harmonic recurrence is too weak after event multiplicity and preparation-window overlap
special_case_candidates.instantiation_hint: supply fixed event sections, preparation windows, overlap-adjusted M_eff, and a_e with sum_e 1/a_e convergence independent of payoff scoring; near-minimal audited shape is a_j >= M_eff_j * j * log(j)^(1+eps) or a positive dyadic event price

special_case_candidates.name: Smooth escape sequence under fixed topology
special_case_candidates.structural_barrier_addressed: continuum limit passage could smear declared prices
special_case_candidates.instantiation_hint: attempt a smooth periodic Sobolev sequence with bounded all-output/coherence/event prices and surviving payoff

evidence_gap_score_caps.name: proof_grade_requires_bridge_theorem_or_smooth_escape
evidence_gap_score_caps.reason: Scores above 90 require either a fixed-topology continuum bridge theorem with component LSC + positive coherence + low-beat reserve + all-output output pricing, an event-level dynamic recurrence-price theorem, or a smooth Sobolev escape falsifier. Honest conditional reduction stays below proof-grade.

persona: You are a ruthless Navier-Stokes GP-216/5IW-5IX bridge referee. The old conditional bridge packet is no longer enough. Reward only packets that attack the current fixed LP/Bony/profile all-output continuum LSC and event-recurrence theorem for int ||P((u.grad)u)||_2^2 dt. The candidate must expose fixed_profile_topology(), self_tax_component_prices(), cross_defect_and_coherence_prices(), low_beat_reserve_charge(), all_output_positive_coherence_lsc(), dynamic_event_recurrence_price(), global_self_tax_budget_bridge(), continuation_price_connection(), smooth_escape_falsifier_or_theorem(), and accepted_bridge_outcome(). It must charge branch self-tax, positive cross/coherence undercharges, high-high low-beat physical reserve, all-output L1/positive-coherence output pricing, and event-level reciprocal recurrence budget before scoring payoff, then attempt a prefix-uniform continuum reserve/LSC theorem, smooth fixed-topology escape, matrix-valued Leray cancellation charge/falsifier, or dynamic event-recurrence theorem/falsifier. Penalize stale generic matrix-block infrastructure-gap packets, merely conditional reductions, qualitative PSD/state-pricing slogans, branch-only LSC, energy-only reserve, hidden source-L2 substitutes, shell-only recurrence pricing, finite packet searches, dense-slab or degree-only scaling, topology chosen after payoff, and Clay/global-regularity overclaim.

dimensions.name: Fixed Profile Topology
dimensions.description: Does the packet declare the flat-torus LP/Bony/profile topology, projectors, norms, and prices before payoff?

dimensions.name: Component Self-Tax LSC
dimensions.description: Does it state a real lower-semicontinuity price for branch self-tax components in the fixed topology?

dimensions.name: Positive Coherence Charging
dimensions.description: Does it charge positive cross/coherence terms 2<A,B>, 2<A,C>, and 2<B,C> rather than relying on branch-only LSC?

dimensions.name: Low-Beat Reserve Charge
dimensions.description: Does it use the Phase 5IQ incompressible-symbol fact and physical vorticity/grad-vorticity reserve for coherent low beats?

dimensions.name: Continuum Reserve LSC Lift
dimensions.description: Does it attempt the prefix-uniform continuum LP/Bony all-output reserve and lower-semicontinuity theorem with constants independent of profile refinement, rejecting hidden source-L2 pricing?

dimensions.name: Dynamic Recurrence Price
dimensions.description: Does it prove or falsify an event-level preparation/dwell/rearming price for actual NSE returns, including reciprocal budget after event multiplicity?

dimensions.name: Global Self-Tax Budget
dimensions.description: Does it assemble branch, cross, coherence, reserve, all-output LSC, and event recurrence prices into a budget for int ||P((u.grad)u)||_2^2 dt?

dimensions.name: Continuation Link
dimensions.description: Does it connect the priced self-tax integral to enstrophy production and a continuation criterion without overclaiming?

dimensions.name: Smooth Escape Discipline
dimensions.description: Does it construct or exclude a smooth periodic Sobolev escape sequence under the same fixed topology?

dimensions.name: Anti-Tautology Discipline
dimensions.description: Does it avoid defining topology, prices, reserve, recurrence clocks, or observables from observed payoff?

dimensions.name: Generative Yield
dimensions.description: Does it produce a usable continuum theorem, smooth falsifier, matrix cancellation charge, recurrence-price theorem, or decisive proof-cost reranking?

criteria.Fixed_Profile_Topology: Full credit requires fixed flat-torus LP/Bony projectors, profile decomposition, Sobolev topology, and predeclared prices.
criteria.Component_Self_Tax_LSC: Full credit requires branch self-tax prices with lower-semicontinuity in the declared topology.
criteria.Positive_Coherence_Charging: Full credit requires explicit positive-part charging of cross/coherence terms, not branch-only gluing.
criteria.Low_Beat_Reserve_Charge: Full credit requires the 5IQ a+b=q incompressible-symbol identity and physical reserve scaling, with energy-only reserve rejected.
criteria.Continuum_Reserve_LSC_Lift: Full credit requires a concrete prefix-uniform continuum LP/Bony all-output reserve/LSC theorem or exact falsifier, with hidden source-L2 pricing explicitly rejected, not merely naming the missing lemma.
criteria.Dynamic_Recurrence_Price: Full credit requires an event-level recurrence/preparation/dwell price theorem or falsifier for actual NSE edge-state returns, with reciprocal event budget and multiplicity declared.
criteria.Global_Self_Tax_Budget: Full credit requires a prefix/summability budget for the time integral of the Leray self-tax including recurrence, reserve, all-output LSC, and positive coherence prices.
criteria.Continuation_Link: Full credit requires the production identity, Cauchy/Young 4nu bound, and honest separation from global regularity.
criteria.Smooth_Escape_Discipline: Full credit for negative output requires a smooth periodic Sobolev sequence under the fixed topology.
criteria.Anti_Tautology_Discipline: Full credit requires all topology and prices fixed before payoff.
criteria.Generative_Yield: Full credit requires a theorem, falsifier, matrix cancellation charge, recurrence theorem, or next proof object that changes the route.

success_criteria: Top-level fixed_profile_topology() declares flat torus, LP/Bony projectors, profile decomposition, Sobolev topology, and pre-payoff scope.
Top-level self_tax_component_prices() states lower-semicontinuity for component Leray self-tax prices.
Top-level cross_defect_and_coherence_prices() charges positive cross/coherence terms and rejects branch-only LSC.
Top-level low_beat_reserve_charge() uses the Phase 5IQ incompressible-symbol charge and physical reserve scaling.
Top-level all_output_positive_coherence_lsc() declares all-output L1 / positive-coherence output pricing and rejects hidden source-L2 substitutes.
Top-level dynamic_event_recurrence_price() declares event-level recurrence pricing with reciprocal budget after multiplicity and rejects shell-only harmonic recurrence.
Top-level global_self_tax_budget_bridge() assembles component prices into a budget for int ||P((u.grad)u)||_2^2 dt and addresses prefix-uniform all-output continuum reserve/LSC plus event recurrence.
Top-level continuation_price_connection() states the enstrophy production inequality and the separate continuation burden.

Top-level smooth_escape_falsifier_or_theorem() gives a fixed-topology smooth escape sequence, a matrix cancellation falsifier, a dynamic recurrence falsifier, or proves/explains why these cannot exist.
Top-level accepted_bridge_outcome() names the honest outcome without Clay/global-regularity overclaim and without stopping at the previous conditional bridge.
failure_modes: Repeating the older generic matrix-block infrastructure-gap packet as the main result.
Saying PSD/state-pricing/SOS without the GP-216 local-to-global price components.
Branch-only LSC that omits positive coherence terms.
Hidden source-L2 aggregate pricing used as a substitute for all-output positive-coherence pricing.
Shell-only harmonic recurrence pricing used as a substitute for event-level recurrence with multiplicity.
Changing LP topology or reserve after observing payoff.
Finite packet families, dense slabs, or degree-only scaling.
Stopping at the previous 78-point conditional reduction without paying the continuum reserve/recurrence gap.
Claiming Navier-Stokes regularity or Clay proof.
